ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, this is the schematic diagram of the model of the world's first generator made by Faraday. Put a copper disk in a magnetic field and let the magnetic induction lines pass perpendicularly through the copper disk; in the figure, wires a and b and the central axis of the copper disk are in the same vertical plane; by rotating the copper disk, the closed circuit can obtain a current. If the radius of the copper disk in the figure is L, the magnetic induction intensity of the uniform magnetic field is B, the total resistance of the circuit is R, and the copper disk rotates counterclockwise at angular velocity ω at a uniform speed (viewed from top to bottom). Then which of the following statements is correct (　　)

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, this is the schematic diagram of the model of the world's first generator made by Faraday. Put a copper disk in a magnetic field and let the magnetic induction lines pass perpendicularly through the copper disk; in the figure, wires a and b and the central axis of the copper disk are in the same vertical plane; by rotating the copper disk, the closed circuit can obtain a current. If the radius of the copper disk in the figure is L, the magnetic induction intensity of the uniform magnetic field is B, the total resistance of the circuit is R, and the copper disk rotates counterclockwise at angular velocity ω at a uniform speed (viewed from top to bottom), then what is the magnitude of the current in the circuit?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a horizontally placed copper disk, the disk surface is passed through by multiple vertically downward magnetic field lines, and the magnetic field B is marked beside it; there is a contact a at the left edge of the copper disk and it is connected to a light bulb through a wire, and near the axis of the copper disk there is a contact/wire b; a and b form a closed circuit that takes electricity from the center of the circle to the circumference; the curved arrow in the figure indicates the copper disk rotates. Reasoning: This is a Faraday disk generator. Take a radial narrow strip on the copper disk from the axis center to the edge; the magnitude of the linear velocity at radius r is v=ωr. The magnetic field is perpendicular to the disk surface, so the magnitude of the motional electromotive force generated on the radial element dr is dε=Bvdr=Bωrdr. Integrating along the radius from 0 to L gives ε=∫_0^L Bωrdr=BL^2ω/2. The total resistance of the circuit is R, so the magnitude of the circuit current is I=ε/R=BL^2ω/(2R).
